Class Column.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.layout.Column.Builder
Enclosing class:
Column
public static final class Column.Builder extends Object
Builder for a single column layout. Methods chain; terminate with build() to emit the positioned element list.

  • Method Details

    • spacing

      public Column.Builder spacing(int px)
      Pixel spacing between adjacent children. Must be >= 0.

    • crossAlign

      public Column.Builder crossAlign(CrossAlign align)
      Cross-axis (horizontal) alignment policy. Default CrossAlign.START aligns children to the column's left edge.

    • add

      public Column.Builder add(ElementSpec spec)
      Append an element to this column.

    • add

      public Column.Builder add(PanelElement element)
      Append an ALREADY-CONSTRUCTED element (Pass 3) — bridges the common case of laying out pre-built widgets, including under CrossAlign.FILL. The element must extend AbstractPanelElement (every library widget does) so the layout can reposition it; a bare custom PanelElement throws at build time. See ElementSpec.of(PanelElement).

    • addColumn

      public Column.Builder addColumn(Consumer<Column.Builder> config)
      Append a nested column to this column. See Row.Builder.addRow(Consumer).

    • addRow

      public Column.Builder addRow(Consumer<Row.Builder> config)
      Append a nested row to this column.

    • build

      public List<PanelElement> build()
      Finalize layout and emit positioned elements. Returns a flat List<PanelElement> with childX/childY computed for each child.
